column2: [intro]
In a small seaside village, you’ll find,
The funniest character of all time,
His name is Gérard, the humor king,
And he loves his ginger brew, let me sing.
Ginger Gérard, the king of tenderness,
In his cup, there's liqueur and distress,
Ginger Gérard, with a heart always fair,
He makes the crowd sing with his sweet flair.
With a smile, he lights up the stage,
His ginger is magic, I tell you this with sage,
He makes the big ones laugh, he makes the small ones cheer,
And everyone dances to his melody, sincere.
Ginger Gérard, funny and sensual,
His ginger bewitches, his humor a call so natural,
Ginger Gérard, the stress antidote,
He makes hearts dance, with his natural glee afloat.
[ solo ]
Ginger Gérard, the star of laughter’s light,
The ginger liqueur turns him to delight,
Ginger Gérard, always ready to smile,
He sets the nights ablaze, with jokes that beguile.
[outro]
